# The Codex hooks file of each plugin that has a Codex manifest, as last released: <plugin> <cksum> <version>.
# Codex drops its trust when this file changes, so tests/test_manifest.sh asks the CHANGELOG section named
# here to say "again in `/hooks`". When you change a hooks file: put its new cksum here with the version
# Unreleased and add the note under ## [Unreleased]. The release commit then replaces Unreleased with the
# version it releases (the [Unreleased] section is empty after a release, so a stale line fails).

coremodel 590029789 0.7.0
